title: Water Restored — North Area — May 29
_full_body: If you would like to respond to this notification, please place your response above the dotted line. The north potable water has been restored. Please remember to run water through your bathtub or utility sink first. The irrigation water line was also damaged and is being repaired. We will have the irrigation water restored later on today. Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
